mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fulfillment_attachments (id, fulfillment_id, object_key, file_name, content_type, size_bytes, status, verified_at, verified_by, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{fulfillmentId}, #{objectKey}, #{fileName}, #{contentType}, #{sizeBytes}, #{status}, #{verifiedAt}, #{verifiedBy}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM fulfillment_attachments WHERE fulfillment_id = #{fulfillmentId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE fulfillment_attachments SET status = 'INVALIDATED' WHERE fulfillment_id = #{fulfillmentId} AND status = 'CONFIRMED'
